evals.prompt: /skill:create-surface-verification-adapter. Inspect the ui-service fixture as a disposable consuming repository. Freeze an exact proposal, accept only the synthetic fixture reply `approve`, author through craft-skill, then drive ui-interaction and service-startup. Return the proposal, final identity, evidence, and cleanup result.
evals.expected_output: The declared `.agents/skills` seam receives one manual `surface-verification-ui-service` adapter only after byte-equal approval. Assigned-port readiness, browser submission, persisted state, evidence survival, and owned cleanup pass.
assertions: The proposal binds the exact repository-declared skill seam, complete file manifest, absent baselines, ownership, preservation, and end-to-end proof before approve
The generated skill has exact manual frontmatter and every shared-contract section
Launch uses an assigned port and data root, the browser drive observes both acknowledgement and persisted state, and evidence survives cleanup
No provider, model, cloud, product repair, staging, or shipping policy enters the adapter

evals.prompt: /skill:create-surface-verification-adapter. Use the cli fixture in one disposable repository, with a synthetic exact `approve` only after proposal comparison. Drive set and show through a real pseudo-terminal and report final identity, filesystem state, evidence, and cleanup.
evals.expected_output: One manual `surface-verification-cli-state` adapter is created through craft-skill, binds the exact CLI mechanics, observes stored:alpha and alpha plus the state file, and removes only owned runtime state after evidence export.
assertions: The exact proposal and approval gate precede every generated byte
The adapter owns one PTY, state-root, command-output, filesystem-evidence, and cleanup contract
The final adapter tree identity is stable and symlink-safe
No product or shipping effect occurs

evals.prompt: /skill:create-surface-verification-adapter. Inspect the library-config fixture and this dotfiles repository. Decide whether either needs a product surface adapter and return the complete result without inventing approval.
evals.expected_output: Both repositories decline adapter creation because native static or app-config checks are sufficient. No proposal approval gate, project adapter, feature map, or empty artifact is created.
assertions: The wrapper applies the deep-adapter eligibility test rather than creating by request momentum
Native static checks are selected as sufficient
The result creates no empty adapter or feature map
This dotfiles repository remains the declared decline case

evals.prompt: /skill:create-surface-verification-adapter. Evaluate exact approve, broad affirmation, affected-path drift after approve, a broken host-native launch, and an equivalent existing adapter against the ui-service proposal. Report writes and outcomes for each branch.
evals.expected_output: Only exact unchanged approve may write. Broad affirmation and drift write nothing, broken launch returns blocked product evidence without repair, and equivalent existing identity returns unchanged without duplication.
assertions: Approval is exact and proposal-bound
All affected baselines are rechecked before the first write and drift prevents every write
Broken product behavior remains product evidence
Equivalent adapters are not replaced or duplicated

evals.prompt: /skill:maintain-surface-verification-adapter. Classify stale doctor guidance, a harness gap, product regression, source proximity, adapter age, explicit full audit, an authorized existing-destination assess candidate, and an assess candidate naming a missing adapter.
evals.expected_output: Only stale guidance, harness gap, explicit audit, and the authorized existing destination are eligible. Product regression remains product evidence; proximity and age are ineligible; missing destination cannot create an adapter, wrapper, or shared contract.
assertions: Every eligible branch starts from one exact existing URI and digest
Only existing adapter-owned files may change through craft-skill
Product regression is not repaired
Portable assess cannot create an absent adapter, wrapper, or shared contract

evals.prompt: /skill:maintain-surface-verification-adapter. Apply an authorized adapter-owned guidance update in the self-modification fixture, then attempt assurance before and after final tree and recipe rebind.
evals.expected_output: Pre-rebind assurance is INCONCLUSIVE or blocked. The final tree is re-driven and rehashed, every affected recipe receives the final URI/digest, and only then may later assurance consume evidence.
assertions: The baseline adapter is itself a changed target
The changed stable path is re-driven and cleanup is proved
The final adapter digest changes every naming recipe identity
No verifier adjusts a stale recipe in place

evals.prompt: Load surface-verification-adapter explicitly. Execute the cleanup-retry scenario after complete UI evidence export and state exactly which retry and removals are legal.
evals.expected_output: The first cleanup failure is preserved. One and only one recipe-authorized retry removes the identified adapter-started instance and scratch state; evidence remains and no process-name kill occurs.
assertions: No implicit retry exists
Cleanup ownership is instance-specific rather than process-name-wide
Pre-existing state and evidence are preserved
Residual state or uncertainty is reported rather than hidden

evals.prompt: Run the shared adapter helper contract against a valid adapter, a repeated identity call, one symlink, one missing recipe field, one stale adapter digest, a readiness-only doctor receipt, and a doctor object containing a verifier verdict.
evals.expected_output: Valid calls emit stable sorted-key JSON; repeat identity matches; unsafe tree, incomplete recipe, stale binding, and verdict-bearing doctor input fail with stable errors. No call creates a file or launches a process.
assertions: The tree digest covers every regular file sorted by POSIX-relative path
Recipe identity changes with every semantic field and rehashes an exact named adapter
Doctor validates readiness evidence but cannot carry criterion or aggregate verdict authority
Every failure is nonzero and the helper mutates nothing
